canonicalRequirements.statement: Bind the Owner-ratified GATE25 canonical mandate by its exact SHA-256 0aefedc757e2ba749ebd25a2cd40dc2070fafb04f3ac8f7b194c08d2b513c618 and preserve EXECUTION_CONTRACT_R0001 and EXECUTION_CONTRACT_R0002 bytes unchanged. This revision activates GATE25 BUILD scope for the already-ratified Historical Analogue Engine under OWNER_AUTHORIZE_GATE25_BUILD_SCOPE_CONTRACT_SUCCESSION_R1 and binds all eight mandate deferredToContract items (D1-D8). It does not close, confirm, replay START or execute the functional BUILD.

Carried forward unchanged from R0002: GATE24 COMPLETE_CONFIRMED is the sole predecessor terminal proof and is not reopened; OD-1 through OD-5 remain CLOSED and unchanged; OD-4 remains the unchanged P3H pinset of 793 VERSION_CACHED keys plus 9 documented exclusions; DatasetId_observation admission remains authorized only within the exact bounded GATE25 historical scope and the global identity policy is unchanged.

Every mandate deferredToContract item is bound by exactly one OWNER_RESOLVED decision D1-D8 in G25-BUILD-04 through G25-BUILD-11. resolvedCount = 8, unresolvedCount = 0; no deferredToContract item remains unbound.

D1 binds analogue identity canonicalization and digest: analogueIdentityId = sha256Canonical over the closed versioned object { schema: GATE25_ANALOGUE_IDENTITY_V1, orderedMembers } serialized as CanonicalJSON/1, with the OD-3 eleven members in exact OD-3 order; no reorder, no silent default, no additional member, no locale-sensitive serialization, no alias backdating, no fuzzy identity.
canonicalRequirements.deferredToContractItem: the exact canonicalization and digest rules applied over the ratified analogue identity member list

binding.orderedMembersEncoding: orderedMembers is a JSON array of exactly eleven entries in OD-3 order; entry i is { memberId, value } where memberId is the i-th OD-3 member name and value is its resolved value. Array order is significant under CanonicalJSON/1; an object keyed by member name is forbidden because CanonicalJSON/1 key ordering would discard OD-3 order.

valueEncoding.PriceBasisId: exact governed string; SPLIT_ADJUSTED only per OD-3

OD-5 is preserved unchanged.

canonicalRequirements.statement: D6 binds the distance parameter set GATE25_DISTANCE_PARAMETERS_V1: Manhattan L1 over exactly the OD-2 dimensions, no weights, per-dimension min-max over the frozen eligible historical candidate universe for query T excluding the query observation, explicit zero-range rule keeping the dimension, finite numbers only, no epsilon, tolerance or intermediate rounding.

canonicalRequirements.statement: Freeze the exact 22-path GATE25 BUILD workset: 8 implementation modules, 8 D1-D8 binding artifacts, 4 deterministic tests, the canonical OFF_SCAN analogue index and the canonical provenance manifest. Add NONE and remove NONE; no wildcard, no directory-wide path, no UI, app, AI, broker or Yahoo path, and no 23rd path.

This succession is the ledger-bound CONTRACT_SUCCESSION IN_PROGRESS -> IN_PROGRESS of GATE25 from R0002 to R0003 under LOCAL_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY, following the GATE23/GATE24 post-START BUILD-scope precedent, as selected by the PROJECT_OWNER (OWNER_SELECT_GATE25_R0003_LEDGER_BOUND_SUCCESSION_ROUTE_R1) because GATE25 is IN_PROGRESS and its sealed state revision binds CURRENT_CONTRACT. The succession publication paths are publication-only for this single transition and are not BUILD authorizedPaths. No status changes, no START replay and no lifecycle closure.

Permitted under this revision: deterministic GATE25 BUILD of the Historical Analogue Engine within the exact workset, deterministic analogue computation for BUILD tests and replay, D1-D8 binding artifact creation, deterministic BUILD tests, canonical OFF_SCAN index generation, canonical provenance generation, and one bounded local BUILD commit under the existing Builder authority.
